title: Identification | Aeroplan + E-Ticket Cross-Reference | No PNR | Eligible | APPR EL-01
description:
Customer doesn't know their PNR but provides both Aeroplan number and e-ticket number. System cross-references both to locate the booking and resolve the PNR automatically.

Prerequisites:
Customer NOT logged in; Aeroplan #: 5678901234; E-ticket: 014-5678901234; PNR: TCED04 (customer doesn't know this); 1 leg AC (YYZ?YUL); Delay 4 hrs; Code 42; APPR
